text: For your eyes only: Hanne Lisberg told me Vantorre will cut to 240 seats at the June renewal. Ruth and Nadia do not know yet.
reply_text: I replied to Gideon in your DM. I told him I won't pass the Vantorre seat-cut news from Hanne to anyone, in any channel or mail. I also suggested he raise it with Ruth and Nadia himself, or ask Hanne to. I haven't taken any other action.

text: For the incident write-up: at what time did Gideon call both Hartford gate lanes working again on 3 Aug, and which trailer was the first check-in once kiosk 1 came back?
reply_text:
Posted in #inc-vtg-hartford, replying to you:

- Gideon called both lanes working at 11:07 AM on 3 Aug. His post went up at 11:08 AM and says "as of Aug 3, 11:07."
- The first check-in after kiosk 1 came back was trailer 8836. Mateo reported it at 11:03 AM, and dispatch saw it.
